name: assembly-newsh4-231
summary: Golden horned arm, 168 x 28 px from seven 2x2 pieces in a row: a long brown-gold horn that tapers from a 12 px thick root (right) to a point curving down at the far left, clamped by small grey metal brackets along its top, with raised gold bands near its root, a round ball-like knuckle joint (with a lower lobe hanging to a point), a narrow neck, and the start of a thick gold cylinder cut off at the right edge. Shape language: round, polished brass-like tubes and a ball joint (each about as tall as it is wide, lit from the upper left so the sprite's lower half is dark), with small hard grey clamps.

traits: one long tube tapering from about 12 px thick at the root (cols 85-112, rows 1-12) to a point at col 2 row 25, curving down to the left
round in section: about as tall as it is wide along its length (6 px tall at the root, thinning to the tip), not a flat slab
one mid gold-brown tone; the sprite's lit top edge and dark lower half are light and shadow, not paint
features.note: The baseline script calls it the horn; it is the arm's main body.

traits: a thick gold cylinder 21 px across (rows 1-21) running out past the right edge, open where the assembly ends
round: about as tall as it is wide, its top highlight band (rows 2-5) a curved surface catching light
rounded shoulder at its left end (cols 133-140) with a lit rim on the lower left
features.note: The start of the next arm segment; the baseline calls it the thick ribbed segment.

traits: a round ball joint about 20 x 15 px between the horn root and the thick segment, bulging above and below the horn
a lower lobe hanging to a point near col 126 row 19, with a lit lower-left edge
tall and round like a ball (about 8 px high), not a flat lens
features.note: Round knuckle; the two bright spots on it are sheen.

traits: three raised rings round the horn root at cols 90, 94 and 104 (bright vertical lines in the sprite)
each a thin band slightly proud of the horn, following its round section
small grey metal brackets on the horn: cols 39-45 rows 7-12, cols 58-63 rows 5-9, cols 81-85 rows 2-7, cols 108-112 rows 1-4 (blue-grey)
hard little boxes raised on the horn surface, metallic grey, not gold
features.note: The baseline calls them studs; they read as clamps holding the horn's plating.

traits: a small dark grey square (cols 96-99, rows 8-12) on the lower flank of the horn root
cut in or framed in grey metal, dark inside
features.note: Dark grey port with a lighter grey rim; baseline modelled it as a grey stud.

traits: a thin lit line along the underside of the horn root (row 12, cols 69-117)
a constant-thickness ridge or rod along the lower flank, catching the light on its top edge
features.note: Thin bright line along the part = an edge catching light (rubric).

traits: dark vertical seam lines across the horn at cols 64 and 80
thin dark rings between sections of the horn
features.note: Segment joints of the horn's plating.
